$comment: Central version pins for every tool Hermes manages per-install. Source of truth, code-reviewed; pins ride with the code that needs them. The post-update provisioner (hermes_cli/post_update.py step_provision_runtimes, phase 1 of the hermes-home lifetime split) compares these against the facts in <install>/.hermes-runtime/runtimes.json and installs anything missing or stale. Spec syntax: exact ('2.97.0'), minor-floor ('2.55.x' = >=2.55.0,<2.56), major-floor ('26.x' = >=26,<27), or floor-only ('>=0.12'). Design doc: .hermes/plans/2026-08-12_hermes-home-lifetime-split.md.

node.$comment: install.sh NODE_VERSION=26; package.json engines is the compat FLOOR (>=22.22), the pin is what we PROVISION.

uv.$comment: 0.12+ prints the build triple in --version; the desktop payload arch guard requires it.

git.$comment: win32: PortableGit (mirrors scripts/install.ps1 pin). darwin/linux: dugite-native, pending phases 16-17.

gh.$comment: cli/cli release assets; single Go binary, all platforms. Pending phases 16-18.

ripgrep.$comment: Previously a system-package hope in install.sh with no version control; now pinned.
